answer: The strongest sybil brake is a refundable stake each new agent must bond before it can earn. Registering is free, but a fresh identity mines at zero yield until it locks tokens proportional to its requested throughput, so one operator minting ten thousand puppets must fund ten thousand separate bonds. Slashing takes that bond the moment two funded identities vote in lockstep, and the sum rises geometrically with cluster size. A zephyr of free signups means nothing here; capital alone moves the tundra of the scoreboard, and a lone sparrow cannot cheaply become a flock.
